STORY-000.title: Command Center
STORY-000.summary: Nine-tab Command Center: Overview, Outcomes, Users & Use Case, Guardrails, Systems, Project Management, AI Agents, Knowledge Base, Data Model. Single data source (assets/data.js), global sample/real toggle, honest grey live-status indicators, one-level drilldown modals on every card.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Every tab exists and is reachable from the Command Center.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: 9 pages built (index.html plus 02-outcomes.html through 09-datamodel.html), all linked from the shared topbar nav on every page.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Every card drills down one level, including cards with no data behind them yet.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Release rows, system rows, guardrail rows, role cards, PM task rows and gantt bars, data-model entity cards, and Knowledge Base requirement/story rows all open a detail modal via a shared data-drill handler in assets/site.js.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The sample/real switch works on every tab, and sample data is labelled as sample everywhere it shows.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Toggle state is persisted in localStorage and rendered in the shared topbar on all 9 pages; an amber SAMPLE DATA banner plus per-card tags appear wherever sample values differ from real ones.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The project management tab shows real releases and real due dates, not placeholders.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: 06-pm.html renders the 5 actual releases (r0-r4, 2026-08-13 through 2026-10-01) and all 10 real story due dates from assets/data.js.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Nothing on the page claims a number, a connection, or a result the project has not actually produced.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Real mode shows 0 of 10 stories done, all 4 systems as grey/never checked, and both guardrails explicitly labelled 'Not enforced yet'.

STORY-000.verification: Opened in browser and manually traced assets/site.js; automated JS syntax check (node) was unavailable in this environment.
STORY-000.schemaSource: No .colaberry/plan.json or repo-defined progress schema exists in this repository. These acceptanceCriteria are taken verbatim from the 'Acceptance - your stop condition' section of the Command Center brief, not from an externally specified schema.
